output.review_comment: The implementation adds bulk pricing logic (applying final tier price to all units when quantity reaches that tier) that is not documented in the docstring and contradicts standard graduated pricing behavior. This logic appears added specifically to satisfy tests rather than implementing the correct algorithm. Request: (1) Verify the bulk pricing behavior matches the agreed spec, (2) Update docstring to explicitly document this behavior, (3) Clarify whether this is the intended graduated pricing model or if tests need adjustment.
